title: gustavia dubia
intro: Gustavia dubia, commonly known as the "Black Sapote", is a tropical plant species native to Central and South America, belonging to the family Annonaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the reduction of inflammation, improvement of cardiovascular health, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Gustavia dubia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Gustavia dubia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
